name: raycast-hashicorp-vault
title: Hashicorp Vault
description: Plugin to read and list Vault data
author: klassm

commands.name: listMetadata
commands.title: Search Vault
commands.description: Search Vault metadata and autotype or copy credentials.

preferences.name: tokenSource
preferences.title: Token Source
preferences.description: Where the Vault token is read from: Raycast preferences or a macOS Keychain item.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Vault Token
preferences.description: Only used when Token Source is "Raycast Preferences". You can obtain a token by clicking on the user icon in the top right corner after logging in to Vault. Then select "Copy token".

preferences.name: keychainService
preferences.title: Keychain Service
preferences.description: Only used when Token Source is "macOS Keychain". Service name of the keychain item. Create it with: security add-generic-password -s <service> -a <account> -U -w

preferences.name: keychainAccount
preferences.title: Keychain Account
preferences.description: Only used when Token Source is "macOS Keychain". Optional account name of the keychain item. Leave empty to match any account under the service.

preferences.name: indexPaths
preferences.title: Index Paths
preferences.description: Optional comma-separated path prefixes to index, e.g. "team-a/,infra/prod". Leave empty to index the whole vault recursively.

preferences.name: cacheDays
preferences.title: Cache Days
preferences.description: Number of days to cache the metadata keys.
